license_required.quote: The practice of optometry in the state of Louisiana is declared a professional practice affecting the public health, safety, and welfare and is subject to regulation and control in the public interest.

issuing_authority.value: Louisiana State Board of Optometry Examiners
issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Louisiana State Board of Optometry Examiners.

name.value: Louisiana State Board of Optometry Examiners
name.quote: The Louisiana State Board of Optometry Examiners is created within the Louisiana Department of Health

type.quote: The Louisiana State Board of Optometry Examiners is created within the Louisiana Department of Health and is subject to the provisions of R.S. 36:803. The board shall consist of six members who are actively licensed optometrists in good standing with the board

umbrella_agency.quote: The Louisiana State Board of Optometry Examiners is created within the Louisiana Department of Health

moral_character_required.quote: Be citizens of the United States or possess valid and current legal authority to reside and work in the United States duly issued by the Citizenship and Immigration Services agency of the United States Department of Homeland Security, and be of good moral character.

degree_required.value: Doctor of Optometry degree from an approved school or college of optometry
degree_required.quote: Have graduated from a school or college of optometry approved by the board and hold the graduate level Doctor of Optometry degree.

accrediting_body.value: Board-approved schools and colleges of optometry
accrediting_body.quote: Have graduated from a school or college of optometry approved by the board

exams.name: National Board of Examiners in Optometry (NBEO)
exams.quote: Have reached the required level of performance on those parts of the examination administered by the National Board of Examiners in Optometry required by the board

exams.name: State Board Examination
exams.jurisdiction: state (Louisiana State Board of Optometry Examiners)
exams.quote: Pass the examination required by R.S. 37:1051.

exams.name: Treatment and Management of Ocular Disease examination
exams.quote: If the applicant passes the Treatment and Management of Ocular Disease examination administered by the National Board of Examiners in Optometry or other examination as approved by the board pertaining to the use of pharmaceutical agents and the treatment and management of ocular disease, the applicant shall be deemed to have met the requirement for additional studies in didactic education.

interval_years.quote: All licensed optometrists shall annually: (1) Pay to the board the annual renewal fee

required.quote: accompany the payment of the annual renewal fee with evidence satisfactory to the board of attendance and completion of twelve hours of continuing education.

hours_per_period.quote: attendance and completion of twelve hours of continuing education.

value: current diagnosis and treatment of ocular disease
topical_requirements.quote: Half of the required hours of continuing education shall pertain to ocular and systemic pharmacology and current diagnosis and treatment of ocular disease and shall be obtained through an in-person classroom setting.

available.quote: The board may waive the examination provided in R.S. 37:1051 if the applicant presents to the board a satisfactory certificate of registration from a board of optometry examiners of another state, and if the standard of requirements adopted and enforced by such board is equal to that provided in this Chapter.

requirements.value: Satisfactory certificate of registration from another state board with equal standards
requirements.quote: The board may waive the examination provided in R.S. 37:1051 if the applicant presents to the board a satisfactory certificate of registration from a board of optometry examiners of another state, and if the standard of requirements adopted and enforced by such board is equal to that provided in this Chapter.

exists.quote: The board shall consist of six members who are actively licensed optometrists in good standing with the board and who have practiced optometry in this state for seven years and one consumer member

national_certification.value: National Board of Examiners in Optometry (NBEO)
national_certification.quote: Have reached the required level of performance on those parts of the examination administered by the National Board of Examiners in Optometry required by the board

national_association.quote: Offered by a school or college of optometry accredited by the American Optometric Association Accreditation Council on Optometric Education.

regulatory_model.quote: The practice of optometry in the state of Louisiana is declared a professional practice affecting the public health, safety, and welfare and is subject to regulation and control in the public interest.

credential_type.quote: he shall, within ninety days of the examination date, pay all applicable fees including the original license fee and the original therapeutic pharmaceutical agent certificate fee and shall receive from the board under its seal certificates entitling him to practice optometry in this state.

is_mandatory.quote: No certificate to practice optometry or therapeutic optometry in this state shall be issued to an applicant who fails to pay all applicable fees within the ninety-day period

title_protection.quote: Advertised or held himself out to be an optometrist without having a valid certificate issued by the board.

scope_protection.quote: Practiced or assisted in the practice of optometry, or knowingly permitted or has permitted anyone in his employ or under his supervision to practice or assist in the practice of optometry, in violation of the provisions of this Chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing optometry without a current valid license or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practiced or assisted in the practice of optometry, or knowingly permitted or has permitted anyone in his employ or under his supervision to practice or assist in the practice of optometry, in violation of the provisions of this Chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a license by fraud or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempted to or obtained a license, registration, certificate, permit or any other designation deemed necessary to engage in the practice of optometry by fraud or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeated negligence or incompetence in practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committed repeated occasions of negligence or incompetence in the practice or assistance in the practice of optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony directly related to optometry practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of a felony that the board finds is directly related to the practice of optometry pursuant to R.S. 37:2950

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual intemperance or addiction to alcohol or habit-forming drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is habitually intemperate or is addicted to the use of alcohol or habit-forming drugs.

disciplinary_grounds.description: License revoked, suspended, or disciplined in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had his license, permit, certification, registration or any other designation deemed necessary to engage in the practice of optometry revoked or suspended, or has had other disciplinary action taken, or has had his application for licensure refused, revoked, or suspended by the proper authorities of another state, territory, or country based upon conduct by the licensee similar to conduct that would constitute grounds for action as defined in this Section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report adverse action by another licensing jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to report to the board any adverse action taken by another licensing jurisdiction, government agency, law enforcement agency, or court for conduct that would constitute grounds for action as defined in this Section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report surrender of license while under disciplinary investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to report to the board the surrender of a license, permit, certification, registration, or any other designation deemed necessary to engage in the practice of optometry in another state or jurisdiction while under disciplinary investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report adverse judgment or settlement from malpractice claim
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to report to the board any adverse judgment, settlement, or award arising from a malpractice claim related to conduct that would constitute grounds for action as defined in this Section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Departure from minimal standards of acceptable optometry practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has departed from or failed to conform to the minimal standards of acceptable and prevailing optometry practice, whether or not actual injury to a patient has occurred.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continued practice while having a contagious or infectious disease
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continued practice knowingly having a contagious or infectious disease.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud in connection with optometry practice including Medicaid, Medicare, or insurance fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has committed fraud by a licensee in connection with the practice of optometry, including, but not limited to, Medicaid fraud, Medicare fraud, or insurance fraud.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Deceived or defrauded the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Deceived or defrauded the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in or aided unlicensed practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged, or aided and abetted a person to engage in the practice of optometry without a license, registration, certificate, permit or any other designation deemed necessary to engage in the practice of optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitted another to use his certificate of registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitted another to use his certificate of registration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay fines, penalties, fees, or costs assessed in disciplinary hearing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to pay fines, penalties, fees, or other costs assessed in a disciplinary hearing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct that subverts or attempts to subvert investigation or hearing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any conduct that subverts or attempts to subvert any evaluation, investigation, hearing, fact finding, or other examination, or the administration of any evaluation, investigation, hearing, fact finding, or other examination authorized under this Chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Evaded or assisted another in evading local, state or federal laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has evaded or assisted, directly or indirectly, another person in evading any local, state or federal laws or regulations pertaining to the practice of optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Divulged or revealed confidential or personally identifiable information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has divulged or revealed confidential information or personally identifiable information to a person other than as authorized by state or federal law or the rules of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in false, misleading, or fraudulent advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in false, misleading, or fraudulent advertising as defined by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertised or held out as optometrist without valid certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertised or held himself out to be an optometrist without having a valid certificate issued by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Solicited business from house to house or door to door
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicited business from house to house or door to door either directly or indirectly.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertised reference to controlled dangerous substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has advertised by including any reference, direct or indirect, to any controlled dangerous substances as provided for in Schedules III, IV, or V of the Uniform Controlled Dangerous Substances Law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to furnish information legally requested by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to furnish to the board, its investigators, or representatives any information legally requested by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Used title of Doctor without Optometrist suffix or used optometry titles without proper credentials
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Used the title of "Doctor" or "Dr." as a prefix to his name without using the term "Optometrist" as a suffix to his name or in connection with it; or used the title "Doctor of Optometry", "O.D.", "Opt. D.", or "D.O.S." without holding a diploma from an accredited school of optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had professional connection with or loaned name to illegal practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a professional connection with or loaned his name to an illegal practitioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refused or neglected to display certificate as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refused or neglected to display his certificate to practice as required by R.S. 37:1059.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Purchased or procured certificate with intent to use fraudulently
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Purchased or procured by barter any certificate issued by the board with intent to use it as evidence of his qualification to practice optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Altered materially a certificate with fraudulent intent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Altered materially, with fraudulent intent, a certificate issued by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Used fraudulent, counterfeited, or materially altered certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Used or attempted to use any certificate issued by the board which has been purchased, fraudulently issued, counterfeited, or materially altered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conspired with or facilitated violation by another person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conspired with any other person to violate this Section or any provisions of this Chapter, or in any way facilitated the violation of this Section or any provision of this Chapter by any other person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated pharmaceutical certification or continuing education requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated any provision of R.S. 37:1051(C), 1063, or 1063.1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to complete required continuing education hours for therapeutic certification
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For those who are certified by the board to treat abnormal conditions and pathology of the human eye, failed to complete not less than sixteen clock hours annually of continuing education, at least fifty percent of the content of which shall be comprised of subjects relative to ocular therapy and pharmacology.

definition_quote.value: Optometry means that practice in which a person employs primary eye care procedures including ophthalmic surgery such as YAG laser capsulotomy, laser peripheral iridotomy, and laser trabeculoplasty, except for those surgery procedures specifically excluded in Subsection D of this Section; measures the powers and range of vision of the human eye using subjective or objective means, including the use of lenses and prisms before the eye and autorefractors or other automated testing devices to determine its accommodative and refractive state and general scope of function; and the adaptation, sale, and dispensing of frames and lenses in all their forms, including plano or zero power contact lenses, to overcome errors of refraction and restore as near as possible, normal human vision, or for orthotic, prosthetic, therapeutic, or cosmetic purposes with respect to contact lenses. Optometry also includes the examination, diagnosis, and treatment of abnormal conditions and pathology of the human eye and its adnexa, including the use or prescription of vision therapy, ocular exercises, rehabilitation therapy, subnormal vision therapy, ordering of appropriate diagnostic lab or imaging tests; the dispensing of samples to initiate treatment; and the use or prescription of diagnostic and therapeutic pharmaceutical agents.
definition_quote.quote: "Optometry" means that practice in which a person employs primary eye care procedures including ophthalmic surgery such as YAG laser capsulotomy, laser peripheral iridotomy, and laser trabeculoplasty, except for those surgery procedures specifically excluded in Subsection D of this Section; measures the powers and range of vision of the human eye using subjective or objective means, including the use of lenses and prisms before the eye and autorefractors or other automated testing devices to determine its accommodative and refractive state and general scope of function; and the adaptation, sale, and dispensing of frames and lenses in all their forms, including plano or zero power contact lenses, to overcome errors of refraction and restore as near as possible, normal human vision, or for orthotic, prosthetic, therapeutic, or cosmetic purposes with respect to contact lenses. Optometry also includes the examination, diagnosis, and treatment of abnormal conditions and pathology of the human eye and its adnexa, including the use or prescription of vision therapy, ocular exercises, rehabilitation therapy, subnormal vision therapy, ordering of appropriate diagnostic lab or imaging tests; the dispensing of samples to initiate treatment; and the use or prescription of diagnostic and therapeutic pharmaceutical agents.

value: ophthalmic surgery (YAG laser capsulotomy, laser peripheral iridotomy, laser trabeculoplasty)
examination and diagnosis of eye pathology
methods_authorized.quote: employs primary eye care procedures including ophthalmic surgery such as YAG laser capsulotomy, laser peripheral iridotomy, and laser trabeculoplasty... measures the powers and range of vision of the human eye using subjective or objective means, including the use of lenses and prisms before the eye and autorefractors or other automated testing devices to determine its accommodative and refractive state and general scope of function; and the adaptation, sale, and dispensing of frames and lenses in all their forms, including plano or zero power contact lenses, to overcome errors of refraction and restore as near as possible, normal human vision, or for orthotic, prosthetic, therapeutic, or cosmetic purposes with respect to contact lenses... the examination, diagnosis, and treatment of abnormal conditions and pathology of the human eye and its adnexa, including the use or prescription of vision therapy, ocular exercises, rehabilitation therapy, subnormal vision therapy... and the use or prescription of diagnostic and therapeutic pharmaceutical agents

drug_authority.value: Diagnostic and therapeutic pharmaceutical agents for diagnosis, prevention, treatment, or mitigation of abnormal conditions and pathology of the human eye and its adnexa; excludes Schedules I and II controlled substances
drug_authority.quote: "Diagnostic and therapeutic pharmaceutical agent" means any prescription or nonprescription drug delivered by any route of administration, used or prescribed for the diagnosis, prevention, treatment, or mitigation of abnormal conditions and pathology of the human eye and its adnexa, or those which may be used for such purposes, and certain approved narcotics, when used in treatment of disorders or diseases of the eye and its adnexa... "Diagnostic and therapeutic pharmaceutical agent" shall not include any drug or other substance listed in Schedules I and II of the Uniform Controlled Dangerous Substances Law

surgery_prohibited.quote: Nothing in this Chapter shall limit an optometrist's ability to use diagnostic or therapeutic instruments utilizing laser or ultrasound technology in the performance of primary eye care or limit an optometrist's ability to perform ophthalmic surgery procedures other than those specifically excluded in Subsection D of this Section.

surgery_definition.value: A procedure upon the human eye in which in vivo human tissue is injected, cut, burned, frozen, sutured, vaporized, coagulated, or photodisrupted by the use of surgical instrumentation such as a scalpel, cryoprobe, laser, electric cautery, or ionizing radiation
surgery_definition.quote: "Ophthalmic surgery" means a procedure upon the human eye in which in vivo human tissue is injected, cut, burned, frozen, sutured, vaporized, coagulated, or photodisrupted by the use of surgical instrumentation such as, but not limited to, a scalpel, cryoprobe, laser, electric cautery, or ionizing radiation.

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: Nothing in this Chapter shall prohibit the dilation and irrigation of lacrimal ducts, insertion and removal of lacrimal plugs, foreign body removal from superficial ocular tissue, suture removal, removal of eyelashes, drainage of superficial lesions of the eye and its adnexa, or corneal shaping with external ophthalmic devices such as contact lenses by optometrists, provided however, no optometrist shall carry out any such procedures referenced in this Paragraph unless certified by the board to treat these abnormal conditions and pathology of the human eye and its adnexa.

laser_procedures_authorized.quote: employs primary eye care procedures including ophthalmic surgery such as YAG laser capsulotomy, laser peripheral iridotomy, and laser trabeculoplasty, except for those surgery procedures specifically excluded in Subsection D of this Section

value: dilation and irrigation of lacrimal ducts
insertion and removal of lacrimal plugs
drainage of superficial lesions of the eye and its adnexa
corneal shaping with external ophthalmic devices such as contact lenses
minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: Nothing in this Chapter shall prohibit the dilation and irrigation of lacrimal ducts, insertion and removal of lacrimal plugs, foreign body removal from superficial ocular tissue, suture removal, removal of eyelashes, drainage of superficial lesions of the eye and its adnexa, or corneal shaping with external ophthalmic devices such as contact lenses by optometrists, provided however, no optometrist shall carry out any such procedures referenced in this Paragraph unless certified by the board

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: He shall have current certification that he has completed a basic course in cardiopulmonary resuscitation, and proof that he possesses in his office an automatic epinephrine injector that is operable and on which the expiration date has not passed.

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: the examination, diagnosis, and treatment of abnormal conditions and pathology of the human eye and its adnexa, including the use or prescription of vision therapy, ocular exercises, rehabilitation therapy, subnormal vision therapy

immunization_authority.quote: In a public health emergency, the state health officer may authorize therapeutically licensed optometrists to administer inoculations for systemic health reasons.

controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: "Diagnostic and therapeutic pharmaceutical agent" shall not include any drug or other substance listed in Schedules I and II of the Uniform Controlled Dangerous Substances Law provided in R.S. 40:963 and 964 which shall be prohibited from use by a licensed optometrist.

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: "Diagnostic and therapeutic pharmaceutical agent" means any prescription or nonprescription drug delivered by any route of administration, used or prescribed for the diagnosis, prevention, treatment, or mitigation of abnormal conditions and pathology of the human eye and its adnexa

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: Licensed optometrists certified by the board to use pharmaceutical agents may direct licensed registered nurses, licensed practical nurses and other healthcare personnel to execute diagnostic and therapeutic orders and administer pharmaceutical agents.

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: The required additional studies shall include a minimum of forty-six clock hours of didactic education and thirty-four clock hours of approved supervised clinical training

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: The required additional studies shall include a minimum of forty-six clock hours of didactic education and thirty-four clock hours of approved supervised clinical training which shall be the equivalent of at least five semester hours of postgraduate education in the examination, diagnosis, and treatment of abnormal conditions and pathology of the human eye and its adnexa.

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: Licensed optometrists certified by the board to use pharmaceutical agents may direct licensed registered nurses, licensed practical nurses and other healthcare personnel to execute diagnostic and therapeutic orders and administer pharmaceutical agents.

impaired_practitioner_program_establishe.quote: The board may, by regulation, defer action with regard to an impaired licensed, registered, or certified person who voluntarily signs an agreement, in a form satisfactory to the board, agreeing not to practice optometry and to enter an approved treatment and monitoring program

criminal_background_check_required.quote: the board may require an applicant as a condition for eligibility for licensure: (1) To submit a full set of fingerprints, in a form and manner prescribed by the board. (2) To permit the board to request and obtain state and national criminal history record information on the applicant.
